module.purpose: Implements the useQueries hook for TanStack Query's Preact adapter, running multiple queries in parallel with combined results, suspense, and error boundary support.
module.summary: The file provides the useQueries Preact hook wrapping core QueriesObserver. It maps user-provided query options through recursive conditional types to enforce correct typing, applies default options from the query client, configures suspense timers and error boundary retry prevention, subscribes to observer changes via useSyncExternalStore, and returns combined results. Complex type helpers infer result types from input arrays with a depth limit to avoid TS recursion.
module.businessContext: Part of TanStack Query Preact integration. Enables parallel queries in Preact apps. If broken, multi-query hooks fail and UI does not update.
functions: useQueries (~L206-325): Preact hook that runs multiple queries and returns combined results

mutationOfArg: observer.setQueries(defaultedQueries, options) updates internal observer state
throws Promise.all(suspensePromises) to suspend component rendering
throws firstSingleResultWhichShouldThrow.error to trigger error boundary
